meta.title: Ondra persona vars & tone
meta.description: Replaces {{user}} / {{char}} / {{relation}} with the address, name and relation the user configured (unknown or empty values are left verbatim so sentences never get holes), then emits one of five tone sections from a 0–100 speech-intensity slider. It only changes reference and density, never a word of the persona text — and the tone section is always separate, never merged into the kernel.
